spec_match.rationale: Answers the dialog's language-matching question with the platform's own machinery — Intl.getCanonicalLocales, data availability, lookup/best-fit matching against navigator.languages — which is the same locale data the SPC validation consults.

interactive.rationale: Tag-list input, matcher select and presets re-run the analysis live; verified the default fr-CA,fr,en-GB list resolved to fr-CA with the correct no-shared-language warning against this browser's en-US.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises well-formedness, data availability and best-fit resolution per tag, all delivered in the table and facts.

edge_cases.rationale: Malformed tags, tags without data, and the no-overlap refusal shape are all first-class outcomes, with the caveat that the dialog's translation set is smaller than Intl's data.

conformance.rationale: The suite's intl-can-answer-the-matching-question and user-languages assertions mirror this page; 7 pass / 0 fail on Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): the analysis ran live against the real navigator.languages (en-US), table and facts populated correctly and the detail articulated the exact refusal shape Chrome 154 introduces; console clean, screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs tag counts, resolution and user-match per run.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, facts as dl, captioned table, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled inputs and matcher select, captioned table with scoped headers, aria-live detail.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: At 360x740 DPR3 the document scrollWidth is 418px: the matcher select's long option ('best fit — what an implementation prefers…') and the five-column tag table overflow, clipping the select and the table's data column (mobile screenshot read).

openQuestions.title: Fix the 418px-wide layout at a 360px viewport
openQuestions.detail: The #matcher select's long option text fixes its intrinsic width and the five-column tag table lacks wrapping, so the page overflows to 418px at 360px, clipping the select and the table's right columns. Shorten the matcher option labels (move the explanation into the note), add max-width:100%/min-width:0 to the select, and give the table cells overflow-wrap:anywhere; re-verify with deno task responsive-check.

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/secure-payment-confirmation-locale-validation/locale-list/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). The analyser is genuinely live — canonicalisation, data availability and best-fit resolution all computed against this browser's real en-US preference, and the default list produced the exact no-shared-language shape Chrome 154 refuses, clearly narrated. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; feature /conformance/ ran 7 pass / 0 fail. The one real defect is responsive: 418px scrollWidth at 360px from the long matcher option and the five-column table, failing mobile parity until they wrap.
